offering_description.value: Develops and sells design, engineering and construction software used to design, simulate, manage and make buildings, infrastructure, products and media. Customers are architects, engineers, contractors, manufacturers and media studios. Delivered mainly as cloud-connected subscriptions.

primary_products.value: computer-aided design software; building information modeling software; product design and manufacturing software; construction management software; media and entertainment animation software

primary_services.value: cloud platform services; consulting and training; technical support

customer_segment.value: B2B: architecture, engineering, construction, manufacturing and media firms; B2C: individual hobbyists, students and makers; B2G: public agencies and education institutions using design software

end_markets.value: architecture, engineering and construction; manufacturing; media and entertainment; infrastructure; education

revenue_model.value: subscription: recurring software and cloud subscriptions; transaction or usage fees: consumption-based cloud usage and flex tokens; service fees: consulting, training and support
revenue_model.category: subscription; transaction or usage fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: develops design and make software and cloud platform, sold to professionals and firms

geography_served.value: global: Americas, Europe, Middle East, Africa and Asia-Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: AEC, manufacturing, and media and entertainment design software sharing cloud platform and customers

distribution_channels.value: partners / resellers: value-added resellers and distributors; online: direct web store and self-service subscriptions; direct sales: sales teams for large enterprise accounts

regulatory_exposure.value: low: general business, data privacy and export control rules
